errors.text_span: Няма процентно изражение, включено вътре в отделните сектори,
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly claims there are no percentage labels inside the sectors. The pie chart clearly displays the percentage value within each slice: 40.9%, 36.4%, 13.6%, and 9.1%.

errors.text_span: но диаграмата е визуално подредена, като голям процент е представен от най-големите сектори.
errors.evidence: This statement is tautological ("large percentage is represented by the largest sectors") and inaccurately suggests a specific visual ordering. The slices are not arranged in descending or ascending order of size.
The verb "свързва" (connects) is an awkward and unclear choice for describing what the sector represents. The verb "представлява" (represents), used for the other sectors, would be more appropriate.
